prompt: Transcribe this audio verbatim, word for word, in the language spoken, keeping fillers such as "um" and "uh". Mark every non-verbal sound the speaker makes at the point where it happens, with one of these tags: [breath] for an audible breath, usually an inhalation before or between phrases; [laughs] for laughter or a chuckle, including laughing while speaking; [coughs]; [sighs]; [sniffs]; [clears throat]; [gasps]; [cries]; [groans]; [sneezes]; [yawns]. Tag only sounds you can clearly hear, never guess. Output only the tagged transcript.
